source: Finalis Disclaimer SOPs for LMM + Language Guide, read verbatim. Every required_text and every fix below is quoted from those two documents. Nothing here is invented, and nothing is paraphrased: if the wording is wrong, it is wrong in the same way the SOP is, and Compliance ratifies the fix.

tiers.A: Deterministic. A block of required text is present, correct and legible, or it is not.
tiers.B: Conditional. The rule fires because of what a page carries, then the same presence test runs.
tiers.C: Flagged for a human. Never cleared, never passed, never counted as clean.

rules.name: Incorporation by reference of the Finalis Disclaimers
rules.required_text: The reader agrees to the provisions set forth on those certain "Disclaimers" located at https://www.finalis.com/disclaimers and the terms thereof are incorporated by reference as though fully set forth herein
rules.fix: The reader agrees to the provisions set forth on those certain “Disclaimers” located at https://www.finalis.com/disclaimers and the terms thereof are incorporated by reference as though fully set forth herein, and references therein to (i) “Company” means the entity in connection with this transaction (together with its affiliates, subsidiaries, successors and assigns), (ii) “Banker” means the registered representative of Finalis Securities LLC in connection with this transaction and (iii) “Bank” means {Bank Name}. Securities are offered through Finalis Securities, LLC member FINRA/SIPC.

rules.name: Broker-dealer line
rules.required_text: Securities are offered through Finalis Securities, LLC member FINRA/SIPC
alternates: Securities offered through Finalis Securities LLC Member FINRA/SIPC
rules.fix: Securities are offered through Finalis Securities, LLC member FINRA/SIPC.

rules.name: Separate and unaffiliated entities
rules.required_text: and Finalis Securities LLC are separate, unaffiliated entities
rules.fix: [Firm Name] and Finalis Securities LLC are separate, unaffiliated entities.

rules.name: Institutional legend on the first page
rules.fix: For institutional investors only

rules.name: Institutional legend must not appear on retail material
rules.fix: Remove the institutional legend: the audience includes natural persons, so the material is a retail communication and needs the retail treatment instead.

rules.name: Not an offer, retail audience
rules.required_text: This communication is intended only to provide general information about potential investment opportunities and to gather indications of interest. It does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security
rules.fix: This communication is intended only to provide general information about potential investment opportunities and to gather indications of interest. It does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security. Securities offered through Finalis Securities LLC Member FINRA/SIPC. [Firm Name] and Finalis Securities LLC are separate, unaffiliated entities.

rules.name: Disclaimer too small to read
rules.fix: Set the disclaimer at a readable size. FINRA recommends font size 10 for a general-size advertisement; a legend the reader cannot read is not a legend.

rules.name: Source on a statistical exhibit
rules.fix: Source: Information provided by Sponsoring/Issuing Company.

rules.name: Forecast, forward-looking statement or projection
rules.required_text: Fundamental data and forecast supplied by management of the Company. Such projections may not be realized. Past performance may not recur, and there is no guarantee of future results
rules.cross_reference: Please see important forecast disclosures at the end of this presentation
rules.fix: Fundamental data and forecast supplied by management of the Company. Such projections may not be realized. Past performance may not recur, and there is no guarantee of future results.

rules.name: Projection chart or illustration
rules.required_text: This is an illustration only and is not intended to forecast the performance of a specific investment or strategy
rules.fix: The issuer and/or sponsor believe that the hypothetical illustration provided is reasonable based on comparable peer valuations and/or applying mathematical principles. This is an illustration only and is not intended to forecast the performance of a specific investment or strategy.

rules.name: Past or present performance
rules.citation: SOP (b) Historical or present data of performance
rules.required_text: Past performance may not recur, and there is no guarantee of future results
rules.fix: Past performance may not recur, and there is no guarantee of future results.

rules.name: Preferred return
rules.required_text: Preferred returns are part of the deal structure and indicate the sequence of how distributions
rules.fix: Preferred returns are part of the deal structure and indicate the sequence of how distributions (from operations or a capital event) are disbursed. They are not guaranteed and should not be considered a financial projection. Actual cash flow projections and distributions from the sponsor may differ from the preferred return.

rules.name: Distributions
rules.trigger_regex: \b(distributions? (of|yield|rate)|monthly distributions?|quarterly distributions?|paid distributions?|distribution history|cash distributions?|are paid quarterly|are paid monthly)\b
rules.required_text: Distributions are not guaranteed and may be discontinued at any time
rules.fix: Distributions are not guaranteed and may be discontinued at any time. Additionally, the presentation must disclose the components of the distribution rate (fund operations, return of capital, borrowings, or proceeds, etc.).

rules.name: Corporate logos
rules.trigger_regex: \b(strategic partners?|our (partners|clients|investors)|backed by|trusted by|portfolio companies|as seen in|selected (clients|investors))\b
rules.required_text: Corporate logos do not represent endorsements
rules.fix: Corporate logos do not represent endorsements.

rules.name: Testimonial or endorsement
rules.required_text: This testimonial may not be representative of the experience of other customers. There is no guarantee of future performance or success
rules.fix: This testimonial may not be representative of the experience of other customers. There is no guarantee of future performance or success. Each individual customer experience may differ and vary, and may not always be representative of the services paid for.
rules.action: Ask the banker whether this was a paid testimonial. If the individual was paid more than $100 in value, add: “The customer featured in this testimonial was paid more than $100.”

rules.name: Award, ranking or recognition
rules.required_text: criteria used to determine the award
rules.fix: Add a disclosure naming the awarding organization and its role in the selection process, the criteria used to determine the award or ranking, the time period covered, and whether any fees were paid for participation, consideration or receipt of the award.

rules.name: Private real-estate offering
rules.required_text: Investments in private offerings are illiquid and speculative and you must be able to sustain a full loss of your investments
rules.fix: Investments in private offerings are illiquid and speculative and you must be able to sustain a full loss of your investments.

rules.name: Audience cross-check
rules.fix: The declared audience and the material disagree. Correct the questionnaire, or correct the deck, before the review goes further: this single answer decides whether pre-use principal approval is legally required.

rules.name: LinkedIn call to action
rules.trigger_regex: \b(comment below|send me a (direct message|dm)|reach out privately|dm me|message me|drop a comment)\b
rules.required_text: Finalis does not permit interactive activities related to securities business on social media
rules.fix: Please note that Finalis does not permit interactive activities related to securities business on social media. Accordingly, you may not interact with this LinkedIn post for securities-related purposes.

rules.name: Email about an offering
rules.required_text: This communication is only intended to provide general information about a particular investment opportunity and to gather indications of interest. It does not constitute an offer of a security
rules.fix: This communication is only intended to provide general information about a particular investment opportunity and to gather indications of interest. It does not constitute an offer of a security.

rules.name: Article, newsletter or educational content
rules.required_text: This material has been prepared for information and educational purposes only, and it is not intended to provide, nor should it be relied on for tax, legal, or investment advice
rules.fix: This material has been prepared for information and educational purposes only, and it is not intended to provide, nor should it be relied on for tax, legal, or investment advice. You should consult with your own tax, legal, and financial professionals for your specific situation. The views and opinions expressed in this article are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the views or opinions of Finalis Securities, LLC. Securities offered through Finalis Securities LLC Member FINRA/SIPC. [Firm Name] and Finalis Securities LLC are separate, unaffiliated entities.

rules.name: Superlative or absolute claim

terms.suggested: strives to be among the best
reduce certain risks, with the risks that remain described
with certain risks reduced, and the remaining risks described

rules.fix: Confirm the statement is true and add a source. If it cannot be substantiated, replace it with a non-absolute term.

rules.name: Promissory language

terms.suggested: is projected to generate, subject to the forecast disclosure
is intended to reduce certain risks
is intended to reduce certain risks
structural features intended to reduce downside, which are not a guarantee
structured with features intended to reduce loss of principal, which are not a guarantee

rules.fix: Flag to the Compliance Officer. Promissory language about returns, cash flow or risk is not resolved by a disclaimer.

rules.name: Fear, urgency or scare tactics

terms.suggested: the offering period is expected to close on [date]

terms.phrase: there are no other investments like this
you don't want to lose out
minimum investment requirements are being waived

rules.fix: Remove the content or replace it with a neutral statement of fact. Intimidation and urgency are not permitted.

rules.name: Comparison to another fund, investment or firm
rules.fix: Flag to the Compliance Officer. Comparisons need an identified benchmark, a measurement period and equal prominence.

rules.name: Disparaging statement
rules.fix: Flag to the Compliance Officer. Disparaging remarks about competitors, the industry or regulators are not permitted.

rules.name: Legal or disciplinary history
rules.fix: Flag to the Compliance Officer.

rules.name: Complex or technical for a retail audience

terms.suggested: explain the term or remove it
explain the term or remove it
explain the term or remove it
explain the term or remove it
explain the term or remove it
explain the term or use percentages

rules.fix: The audience includes natural persons. Explain the term in plain language or remove it.

rules.name: Indiscriminate bolding or underlining
rules.fix: Reserve bolding for headings and subheadings. Emphasis spread through the body copy unbalances the material in favour of the benefits.

rules.name: Benefits without risks on the same page
rules.fix: Risks and benefits must be presented with equal prominence. Add the balancing risk language to this page.

not_implemented_locally: Promissory images (money trees, gold, yachts): needs vision, out of scope for the local engine.
Substantiation of a factual claim: needs judgement and outside sources.
Cherry-picked realized holdings: needs the full set of holdings to compare against.
